approvedHardInvariants.provenanceRationale: The Paris Engine API specification directly defines the valid-head no-build response branch in repository-owned markdown.
approvedHardInvariants.ruleText: A valid head without a started build process must yield `{payloadStatus: {status: VALID, latestValidHash: headBlockHash, validationError: null}, payloadId: null}`.

approvedHardInvariants.provenanceRationale: The Paris Engine API specification directly defines that the second positional parameter accepts explicit null.
approvedHardInvariants.ruleText: The second positional parameter accepts explicit `null` as well as `PayloadAttributesV1`.

approvedHardInvariants.provenanceRationale: The Paris Engine API specification directly defines that payloadId accepts explicit null in the no-build branch.

deferredRules.deferReason: Sequencing requirement is deferred to later runtime-driver and normalization work.
deferredRules.ruleText: `payloadAttributes` must be processed only after successful forkchoice application and only when `headBlockHash` is `VALID`.

deferredRules.deferReason: Rollback behavior requires fuller runtime execution context than T01 provides.
deferredRules.ruleText: If `payloadAttributes` validation fails, the forkchoice update must not be rolled back.

scenarios.notes: The MVP oracle only asserts payloadId-bearing response shape and getPayload return semantics for a known local payloadId.

approvedHardInvariants.provenanceRationale: The Paris Engine API specification directly defines the valid-head build-started response branch and payloadId-bearing shape.
approvedHardInvariants.ruleText: A valid head with a started build process must yield `{payloadStatus: {status: VALID, latestValidHash: headBlockHash, validationError: null}, payloadId: buildProcessId}`.

approvedHardInvariants.provenanceRationale: The Paris Engine API specification directly defines the engine_getPayloadV1 return semantics for a known build process.
approvedHardInvariants.ruleText: Given `payloadId`, the client must return the most recent payload version available in the corresponding build process at call time.

deferredRules.deferReason: Build-process creation semantics are deferred until runtime state control exists.
deferredRules.ruleText: Valid `payloadAttributes` must start a build process on top of `headBlockHash` and produce `buildProcessId`.

deferredRules.deferReason: Payload validation success semantics are deferred until runtime scenarios and normalization are implemented.
deferredRules.ruleText: If payload validation succeeds, the response must be `{status: VALID, latestValidHash: payload.blockHash}`.

scenarios.notes: The MVP oracle keeps only the valid-ancestor shortcut response shape as a hard invariant.

approvedHardInvariants.provenanceRationale: The Paris Engine API specification directly defines the valid-ancestor shortcut response shape with payloadId null.
approvedHardInvariants.ruleText: In the valid-ancestor shortcut case, the response must be `{payloadStatus: {status: VALID, latestValidHash: headBlockHash, validationError: null}, payloadId: null}`.

deferredRules.deferReason: Skip-update and do-not-build behavior are deferred until repeated-call runtime traces are available.
deferredRules.ruleText: If `headBlockHash` references a `VALID` ancestor of the canonical head, the client may skip the forkchoice update and must not start payload building.
